mathematical_scope: For every integer m>=2 and alternating stationary ratio 0<r<=1, exact SLEM minimization among all reversible nearest-neighbor or holding kernels on the simple cycle with 2m vertices.
scientific_integrity: A full analytic proof gives a global optimum via stationary-flow symmetry averaging, Fourier blocks and constrained one-variable minimax. Finite tests support but do not establish the all-parameter claim. All-ratio novelty has been checked against specified sources but is not guaranteed, and uniqueness of arbitrary asymmetric optimizers is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The criterion concerns SLEM and only reversible nearest-neighbor plus self-loop chains, not all measures of finite-time mixing.
Nonreversible chains, arbitrary target masses and longer-range transitions are outside the theorem.
The symmetric kernel is an existing optimizer; asymmetric uniqueness is not asserted.
Independent audit and exhaustive novelty certification have not been performed.
title: Sharp stationary-bias threshold for optimal Metropolis mixing on alternating cycles
